Every source is weighted EQUALLY because no source has ever been graded here. projection_snapshot_2026.json is what makes January able to weight them.

C1_band_ratio_preserved.why: if the ceiling PERCENTAGE is not identical to Draft Sharks own, we have invented a band rather than carried one across

C2_ordering_by_the_blend_differs_from_an.why: a blend that reproduces one source exactly is not a blend

C3_centering_is_per_position.why: a single GLOBAL offset was wrong: Draft Sharks runs 25.6 points LOW on quarterbacks and 10.9 HIGH on receivers, a 36.5-point spread, so one number pushed QBs the wrong way by ~34 and distorted the position balance of the whole blend

C4_coverage_reported.why: a player with no DS band gets NO floor/ceiling rather than an invented one -- the adjuster simply cannot move him, and that is visible
